summary: @servicetitan/ko-bridge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute `math_init.js`, a 727 KB obfuscated single-line file shipped at the tarball root. The `math_init.js` payload is not declared in `package.json` `files` (which lists only `dist` and `src`), and both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` use obfuscator.io-style transforms (numeric identifier names, shuffled string-array + char-code lookup, indirect call wrappers). The delivery pattern executes obfuscated code under an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time, bypassing Node-based tooling. A Knockout/React bridge library has no functional need for a second JS runtime or a large obfuscated blob during install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
